svg.aria-label: Animation of a PXE network boot: DHCP, ProxyDHCP, signed shim and GRUB over TFTP, the menu, kernel and initrd, the Ubuntu ISO and answers file over HTTP, an unattended install, the golden bundle and first boot.
svg.text: From power button to ready host
A bare machine boots from the network and installs itself. No USB stick, no monitor.
